_comment: Paired golden for the AWG cohort fingerprint. Vendored byte-identical into the client repo at core/data/src/test/resources/contract/cohort-fingerprint.golden.json. The server test (tests/unit/test_bundle_schema.py) and the client test (RipdpiBundleContractTest) each compute the fingerprint from `params` in their own language and assert it equals `fingerprint`. Same bytes, two implementations => the bash/python emit side and the Kotlin parse side can never silently disagree on the algorithm. Params are the narrow-junk-sequential cohort (ansible/roles/amneziawg/vars/cohorts/narrow-junk-sequential.yml).
